From: Laitner, Bill

To: Myers, Gene <gmyers@freepress.com>
Subject: National Public Radio interview request

Lynn Jolicoeur, (JOLL-ick-er), producer of All Things Considered the public radio show at WBUR-Boston, 617-358-1460, wants to interview someone in the next 2 hours about Dave Dombrowski, and it could be Anthony or anyone else who is knowledgable.
